person_words: We run a small online bookshop selling about 400 books a month at £12 each. We're deciding between running a monthly email newsletter (starting next month) or cutting prices by 10% straight away. The newsletter might add 5 to 15% more orders but could also annoy some customers. A price cut usually lifts orders, though it squeezes margin. A risk is that a big competitor launches a sale, which could cut our orders by around 20%. We want monthly revenue to be higher in six months' time.
